requirements.obligation: Every external effect MUST enter the existing kernel/native dispatch ownership path.
Serialized or reconstructed evidence MUST NOT manufacture live ownership.
A workflow MUST have at most one unresolved effectful continuation.
An unknown, delivered-but-denied or awaiting-report operation MUST NOT authorize a replacement effect.
Disclosure/endorsement MUST NOT reduce retained confidentiality or influence history.
All authorization checks MUST bind tenant, authority domain, process and exact action; mismatches refuse.
Stale serving/coordinator epochs MUST be rejected at every authoritative mutation and capture.
Missing/corrupt evidence, unknown variants, dependency failure and bounded-resource exhaustion MUST fail closed.
Every data-bearing release MUST be audience-governed for every enabled profile channel, including explanations, errors and retained outputs.
Cancellation, expiry and Drop MUST NOT imply rollback of an accepted or uncertain external effect.
Policy and semantic packages MUST NOT widen the caller's capability authority.
Safety claims MUST identify coverage, assumptions and source/evidence versions.
Pure planner/contracts crates MUST have no effectful platform dependencies or ambient state reads.
Live preparation/ownership types MUST be unconstructible from public wire data.
Security variants and identifiers MUST be bounded, closed and non-interchangeable.
Cancellation and unwinding MUST preserve durable ownership and consumed authority.
Async orchestration MUST NOT hold a store transaction across provider awaits.
New code MUST pass owning Clippy, formatting, feature-matrix and dependency-direction checks without relaxed baselines.
Debug, tracing and public errors MUST exclude protected payloads and secret material.
Pure/substrate changes MUST preserve declared MSRV, no_std/alloc builds and deterministic behavior under isolated and unified features.
Live handle auto traits, consuming APIs and supervised task lifetimes MUST preserve exclusive dispatch without relying on Drop or must_use.
Decoding and evidence expansion MUST enforce aggregate limits before allocation or unbounded verification work.
Planner results and workflow directives MUST remain non-authorizing, and request projections MUST account explicitly for every field and digest meaning.
Workflow creation/commands MUST be idempotent and conflict on changed canonical content.
Continuation selection MUST atomically enforce one unresolved effectful continuation.
Approval MUST bind an identity reserved before immutable request admission.
Existing frozen requests MUST never be rewritten to add grants or refreshed authority.
Recovery grants MUST use v2 and refuse downgraded, stripped or cross-workflow bindings.
Owner/compartment approval coverage MUST be verified against operator authority scope.
Approval presentation MUST bind the exact canonical action and authorized preview.
Native capture MUST own the recovery participant, grant consumption and budget join.
Cross-store attachment MUST recover idempotently without assuming a distributed transaction.
Active ownership MUST close only from authoritative final effect/no-effect evidence.
Reconciliation MUST never reset consumed grants or create a fresh identity for an uncertain effect.
A bounded plan's prerequisite edges MUST reference verified effects under exact scope and provenance.
Withheld output MUST preserve completed-effect identity and prevent replacement dispatch.
Offer use MUST revalidate scoped versions, fresh revocation, budget and time.
Existing pending native approval operations MUST retain their owning resume protocol.
Capture MUST distinguish the proven same-call input observation from unrelated source-generation changes.
Exact offers and approvals MUST bind materialized step inputs; accepting a plan MUST NOT authorize unknown future output or bypass per-step authority.
Approval/grant issuance MUST retain one exact challenge-bound body across signing, lost acknowledgements, expiry and restart.
Admission intent MUST be durable before entering the kernel, and closure MUST fence late admission using authoritative state even when projections are absent.
Partial or failed-after-effect settlement MUST spend the step identity independently of result availability and cancellation.
Reservation finalization MUST reuse the existing complete process binding and charge the logical-call slot exactly once.
Approval and coverage MUST bind the exact unsigned authorization requirements and satisfy every required authority class for the same action without cycles or duplicated approvers.
Finalization MUST retain recoverable exact request and fixed authorization custody separately from credential-free native history.
Recovery MUST preserve operation-owned nonce preflight, exact issuance attachment and phase-specific closure without rewriting the frozen process envelope.
Counterfactual evaluation MUST operate only on explicit bounded facts and have no effect ports.
Cross-store observations MUST retain versions and uncertainty without claiming global atomicity.
Advice/report objects MUST be rejected by every live authority/capture API.
Explanations and candidate existence MUST be projected to the authorized audience.
Search MUST be deterministic, bounded and explicit about incompleteness.
Signed reports MUST bind expected signer, deployment, snapshot, intent and recomputed result.
Live use MUST freshly validate relevant observations rather than trust a prior feasible result.
Projected reports and authorization references MUST NOT expose unauthorized transitive commitments or low-entropy secret digests.
Package publisher identity MUST remain distinct from tenant deployment authority.
Every exposed tool/channel MUST have complete authenticated coverage or refuse.
Policy composition MUST expose resolved precedence and preserve kernel/operator ceilings.
Recipient resolution MUST bind the actual provider/account/resource and enforced transport.
ACL observations MUST be scoped, fresh, complete and fail closed on uncertainty.
Dynamic annotators MUST have explicit bounded powers; confidence MUST NOT grant authority.
Influence/endorsement MUST be independent of confidentiality and transport authentication.
Transformation release MUST bind exact inputs, code, output, authority and purpose.
A one-shot crossing MUST NOT create reusable public artifact authority.
Bound output disposition MUST cover success, failure, stream and alternate channels without raw fallback.
Reload MUST activate a complete verified generation while preserving captured historical operations.
Provider submission and any retry MUST obey the qualified native effect contract, including deduplication scope, lifetime and complete effect cardinality.
Prerequisites MUST distinguish historical facts, current predicates and held reservations at the dependent effect boundary.
Artifact identity MUST bind content version and provenance without treating hashes as bearer authority.
Publication MUST recover safely across every byte-store/metadata-store cutpoint.
Missing or corrupt metadata/bytes MUST quarantine the version without public fallback.
Reads MUST commit required knowledge and validate exact bytes before model/agent release.
Copy/move/export/import MUST preserve governed provenance across aliases and tenants.
Derivation MUST join all inputs unless exact scoped projection authority is verified.
Checkpoint/model restore MUST join retained knowledge and preserve provider context identity.
Legacy unlabeled state MUST require quarantine and explicit adoption.
GC and deletion MUST retain ownership/replay tombstones and live version pins.
Existence, error, digest and deduplication channels MUST obey audience policy.
Filesystem enforcement MUST mediate mutation rather than rely on observation after writes.
Artifact/return releases MUST join native scoped knowledge and retain release identity before delivery, including concurrent dispatch and uncertain acknowledgement.
Ordinary child creation MUST preserve inherited knowledge and authority attenuation.
A confined lineage/epoch MUST require host-issued boundary authority and admitted seed provenance.
Sensitive observation MUST wait for verified enforcement and provider-context identity.
Return release MUST bind exact artifact, child, parent, boundary, policy and scoped authority.
Parent knowledge MUST be committed before return bytes are delivered.
Success, failure, logs, progress, files and streams MUST share the declared release boundary.
Schema compliance MUST NOT substitute for disclosure or integrity authority.
Restart, cancellation and duplicate spawn/return MUST preserve logical identity and consumed resources.
The parent tree's budgets and limits MUST include confined work and its recovery.
Confined launch MUST mediate every parent-influenced seed, control and metadata channel using the parent's current knowledge.
All SDK/CLI paths MUST share Rust-owned recovery semantics and stable command identity.
Required enforcement features MUST be bound to the deployment/admission profile and resist downgrade.
Shared generated wire vectors MUST reject malformed or unknown signed bindings.
Protected setup MUST prove required mediation/self-test coverage before accepting protected work.
Time and key changes MUST refuse stale authority without corrupting historical recovery.
Store upgrades/rollbacks MUST preserve original identities and reject incompatible serving binaries.
Policy feedback MUST remain a classified proposal with separate deployment authority.
Telemetry MUST be audience-safe and never substitute for durable ownership/audit state.
Reconciliation MUST retain bounded reserved capacity under overload.
Cancellation and notification failures MUST not create new effect attempts.
Command replay MUST resolve committed identity before stale-revision rejection and freshly authorize every returned projection without reapplying mutations.
New recovery intake MUST obey durable per-tenant/authority quotas while preserving headroom and ownership for existing unresolved work.
Historical settlement MUST use scoped current recovery authority independently of expired initiating authority, without creating execution rights or bypassing current release checks.
Trajectories MUST assert effects, authority and retained knowledge alongside decisions.
Every security negative MUST have a successful relevant benign counterpart.
Crash campaigns MUST use fresh processes and independent effect/evidence checks.
Mutation tests MUST reject the intended broken invariant rather than incidental fixture failure.
Concurrency/parser/model tests MUST map to actual owning components before qualification.
Comparative trials MUST match tasks, actors, authority and competent recovery baselines.
Published metrics MUST preserve denominators, uncertainty, unsupported cases and source/profile identity.
Feature acceptance MUST include bounded-resource overload and declared performance budgets.
